subject: Bridge extension & amendment request for CloudSprint pilot
messages:
From: Elliot Grant <elliot@cloudsprint.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudsprint.ai
Date: 2026-06-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — 10-day bridge for pilot?

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was really impressed with the latency/throughput numbers. We started ingesting a larger dataset yesterday and ran into a gating issue with one of the connectors; as a result our data validation pipeline is behind and we won’t be able to complete the pilot evaluation within the original timebox.

We’d like to ask for a short bridge: an additional 10 calendar days to finish ingestion and run the evaluation. We expect roughly 80% of planned calls during the extension window. Could Redwood do a 10-day extension and either: 1) bill only for actual usage during the extension at the standard rate, or 2) offer a small discounted top-up (e.g., 20% off extension usage) since this was caused by an integration issue on our side? We’re open to either approach — main need is runway to complete the success criteria.

I’ve attached the current usage export for the pilot and a short note from our security team outlining one remaining checklist item (will follow up).

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement will need a note for PO timing if we proceed.

Best,
Elliot Grant
Head of Product, CloudSprint
E: elliot@cloudsprint.ai
A: CloudSprint, Inc.

Attachments:
- usage-summary.csv (CSV export of ingestion + request counts)
- security-checklist.pdf (sent separately)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Elliot Grant <elliot@cloudsprint.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 10-day bridge for pilot?

Hi Elliot — thanks for the heads up and for sending the usage export. Sorry to hear about the connector trouble. We can absolutely support a short bridge so your team can complete the validation.

Options that would work from our side (pick whichever you prefer):

1) 10‑day extension at no upfront charge — you only pay for actual usage during the extension at your current pilot rates. No SLA increase; production traffic gating not recommended in this mode.

2) 14‑day extension with a 20% discount on all usage during the extension window (applies to token-generation and embedding units). We find a slightly longer window reduces churn risk from late test cases.

3) Convert up to 5 unused pilot days into a prepaid credit bucket to be consumed within 30 days post-extension. Credits are priced at pilot rates (no discount) and give you flexibility for burst testing.

If you choose option 2 we can send a one-page amendment for signature and aim to have the extension dates set immediately after PO. If procurement needs formal language, we can include a short amendment that references the existing SOW and adds the extension term. I’ve drafted a concise amendment and attached it here (amendment-draft.docx) for your reference.

Next steps: let me know which option you prefer and whether procurement needs a specific ordering code or invoice timing. Ben and Marcus looped in for pricing confirmation and the SOW tie‑out.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
T: +1 (415) 555-0119

Attachments:
- amendment-draft.docx (proposed one-page extension amendment)

From: Elliot Grant <elliot@cloudsprint.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudSprint Procurement <procurement@cloudsprint.ai>
Date: 2026-06-08T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 10-day bridge for pilot?

Lauren\/team — thanks for the fast options. We discussed internally and procurement prefers a short, purchase-order friendly amendment. Given internal timelines, we’d like: 14‑day extension (option 2) and the 20% discount on usage for that window. Procurement asked if you can: 1) include a single line item for the extension on the amendment ("14-day pilot extension — discounted usage") and 2) set net-30 terms on the invoice.

We’ll issue a PO as soon as we have the amendment language; happy to sign electronically. Also — can you confirm whether the discounted price applies to embeddings as well? Our eval includes embeddings-heavy reranking so that piece matters.

If that all looks good we’ll move forward.

— Elliot

On the checklist: security asked for the KMS fingerprint we discussed; I’ll attach that separately today.

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

- Doc flow: I’m sending the amendment into DocuSign now (link below). Once signed we’ll activate the extension effective the day the amendment is countersigned.

Elliot — once signed we’ll reply with an invoice schedule and the amended one-line SOW; plan to have docs completed today if procurement signs quickly.

Thanks,
